SELECT m.id, m.NAME, m.CODE, m.specification, m.material_category_id, m.unit_id, m.is_sub_material AS subMaterial, m.STATUS, m.merge_code, m.dispense_record, u.unit_name, m.remark, m.principal_material_id as principalMaterialId FROM bp_material m LEFT JOIN bp_unit u on m.unit_id = u.id WHERE m.is_deleted = 0
and m.name like concat('%',#{name},'%')
and m.code like concat('%',#{code},'%')
and m.merge_code like concat('%',#{mergeCode},'%')
and m.material_category_id in
#{mId}
order by m.merge_code asc

SELECT id, NAME, code, merge_code, material_category_id AS parentId FROM bp_material WHERE is_deleted = 0 AND STATUS = TRUE
AND (NAME LIKE concat('%',#{keyword},'%') OR merge_code LIKE concat('%',#{keyword},'%'))
